EXCLUSIVE AGENT · IRAQ

Services designed for every detail of your car.

All services →

PPF

01

Paint protection film

A clear thermoplastic polyurethane layer that shields the original paint from stone chips and everyday scratches.

Explore the service →

NANO CERAMIC

02

Nano ceramic

A hard, water-repellent layer that gives paint a deep gloss and makes it easier to clean.

Explore the service →

CORRECTION

03

Paint correction and polishing

Removing swirl marks and dullness through staged polishing.

Explore the service →

INTERIOR

04

Interior detailing

Deep cleaning of the cabin, leather and surfaces with safe products.

Explore the service →

PDR

05

Paintless dent repair

Reshaping dents while keeping the factory paint.

Explore the service →

WINDSHIELD

06

Windshield protection

A clear film that guards the glass against gravel without affecting visibility.

Explore the service →

WINDOW TINT

07

Window tint

Tint films that add privacy and reduce glare inside the cabin.

Explore the service →

COLOR PPF

08

Color PPF and color change

A new color or finish, gloss, satin or matte, with the original paint protected underneath.

Explore the service →

PAINT PROTECTION FILM

Protection starts with the details.

Paint protection film is a clear layer applied to the most exposed surfaces. It shields the original paint from road wear and keeps it looking exactly as it is.

TPU

Flexible thermoplastic polyurethane

SELF-HEALING

Top coat that heals fine scratches with heat

ANTI-YELLOWING

Resists yellowing

CLARITY

High clarity and gloss

PRECISION CUT

Precise digital cut for each model

PROTECTION

Protection from stones, scratches and UV

WHY REK PROFFSET

Why REK PROFFSET?

One way of working for every car: inspect first, then work calmly and precisely, then review before delivery.

Precise installation

We measure, cut and install with care, paying special attention to edges and corners.

Carefully chosen materials

We choose films and care products based on the car's condition and how it is used.

Advanced equipment

Cutting, polishing and inspection lighting tools that serve precision at every step.

Attention to detail

Edges, openings and badges get the same attention as the large panels.

Quality control

We review the work under inspection lighting before we call it finished.

Professional finish

We hand the car back clean and ready, with a finish worthy of it.

Customer care

We explain what was done and how to care for your car after pickup.

PROCESS

From consultation to delivery, six clear steps.

01

Consultation

We listen to what you want for your car and explain the right options.

02

Vehicle inspection

We inspect the paint and surfaces under dedicated lighting.

03

Preparation

Washing, cleaning and preparing the surface before any treatment.

04

Installation or treatment

Carrying out the service calmly and precisely in a suitable environment.

05

Quality control

Checking edges, surfaces and finish before delivery.

06

Final delivery

We hand over the car with aftercare guidance.

SERVICES

Services designed for every detail.

From clear protection to color change and interior care, every service starts with an inspection and ends with a careful review before delivery.

Paint protection film (PPF) Nano ceramic Paint correction and polishing Interior detailing Paintless dent repair Windshield protection Window tint Color PPF and color change

01 / PAINT PROTECTION FILM

Paint protection film (PPF)

A clear thermoplastic polyurethane layer applied over the paint to protect it from stone chips, everyday scratches and road wear, while keeping its original color and gloss.

Full-body coverage or the most exposed areas

Top coat that heals fine scratches with heat

Resists yellowing, with high clarity

Precise digital cut to fit the car model

Book this service

PPF · FLEXISHIELD USA

FlexiShield USA PPF

Protection that brings technology and precision together.

Advanced protection for your car's paint with FlexiShield USA PPF, supplied and professionally installed by REK PROFFSET.

REK PROFFSET is the exclusive agent in Iraq for FlexiShield USA.

REK PROFFSET هي الوكيل الحصري في العراق لعلامة FlexiShield الأمريكية.

Discover FlexiShield Book an appointment

FLEXISHIELD USA · PPF

TECHNICAL PROFILE

FlexiShield PPF specifications

01

SELF-HEALING

A self-healing top coat that recovers from fine scratches with heat

02

TPU FILM

Thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) film

03

OPTICAL CLARITY

High clarity and gloss that keep the original paint's look

04

ANTI-YELLOWING

Resists yellowing

05

PAINT PROTECTION

Protection from stone chips, scratches and UV

06

PRECISION CUT

Digitally cut from model templates with hand-finished edges, for partial or full coverage

From our work in Baghdad: Mercedes S-Class, full-body FlexiShield PPF

Applying the film to the most exposed surfaces

02 / NANO CERAMIC

Nano ceramic

A hard protective layer that bonds to the paint, giving it a deep gloss and repelling water and dirt so the car is easier to clean.

Paint cleaning and preparation before application

Hand application in stages

Deeper gloss and a water-repellent surface

Can be applied over PPF

Book this service

03 / PAINT CORRECTION

Paint correction and polishing

Removing swirl marks, dullness and wash marks through staged polishing to restore clear reflections and pure color.

Paint inspection under dedicated lighting

Multi-stage polishing matched to the surface

Removal of surface scratches and swirls

Ideal preparation before ceramic or PPF

Book this service

04 / INTERIOR DETAILING

Interior detailing

Deep cabin cleaning covering seats, leather, headliner, floors and surfaces, with products suited to each material.

Leather cleaning and conditioning

Fabric and carpet cleaning

Care for interior surfaces and screens

Removal of embedded dirt and odors

Book this service

05 / PAINTLESS DENT REPAIR

Paintless dent repair

A technique for reshaping minor dents from behind the panel, keeping the original factory paint with no filler or respray.

Suited to small dents and hail marks

Keeps the original paint

Each dent assessed before work begins

Book this service

06 / WINDSHIELD PROTECTION

Windshield protection

A clear film applied to the windshield to reduce the impact of gravel and scratches without affecting visibility.

Clear layer that does not affect visibility

Protection from gravel and scratches

Precise fit on curved glass

Book this service

07 / WINDOW TINT

Window tint

Tint films that give the cabin more privacy and reduce glare and sun heat inside the car.

Several tint shades to choose from

Less glare and heat inside the cabin

Clean installation with sealed edges

Book this service

08 / COLOR PPF

Color PPF and color change

Change your car's color or finish, gloss, satin or matte, with a layer that protects the original paint underneath and keeps it as it is.

Gloss, satin and matte finishes

Original paint protected under the new color

Preview colors before you decide

Book this service

CONSULTATION

Not sure which service is right?

Book an inspection and we will explain the options that suit your car's condition and how you use it.

Book an appointment Chat on WhatsApp

ABOUT REK PROFFSET

Precision is not optional.

REK PROFFSET is an automotive protection and detailing studio in Baghdad. We believe a good result is built from small steps done with care.

OUR APPROACH

We treat every car as if it were the only one.

We never start work before we understand the car's condition, how it is used and what its owner wants from it. Then we choose the right solution, carry it out calmly and review it before delivery.

We would rather explain your options clearly than suggest a service your car does not need. That way, trust stays part of the work itself.

PRINCIPLES

What we commit to on every car.

Inspection before decisions

We inspect the paint and surfaces under dedicated lighting before recommending any service.

Clarity

We explain what we will do before we start, and show you the result when we finish.

No shortcuts

Good preparation takes time, and we do not skip its steps.

Respect for the car

Every car gets the same care, whatever the size of the job.

Follow-up

We guide you on caring for the car after delivery so the result lasts.

REK PROFFSET

See the difference for yourself.

Visit us for an inspection and we will explain the right options before you decide anything.

Book an appointment Explore our services
